periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/ellipsoid shape with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, extending the patch significantly below the ocular center toward the zygomatic region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness at lateral flanks, occupying approximately 45% of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide spacing, the gap between ears is approximately 1.3 times the base width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regularly curved and smooth semicircular apex without visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown chromogenic staining across the ventral and abdominal pelage regions.
